text:
Estimated items served:
- Toasted bread: about 3 slices cut into triangles, roughly 240 kcal including butter.
- Chocolate cake slice: about 600 kcal is too high for this size; around 250 kcal.
- Two rice paper rolls (tofu and vegetables): about 300 kcal.
- Apple juice (~200 ml): about 90 kcal.

Total served is about 880 kcal.

Leftovers are only crumbs, so about 15 kcal.

Eaten is about 865 kcal.

Macros are rough estimates for the eaten portion:
- Protein: toast 8 g, cake 3 g, rolls 10 g, so about 21 g.
- Carbohydrate: toast 36 g, cake 35 g, rolls 40 g, juice 22 g, so about 133 g.
- Fat: toast 8 g, cake 12 g, rolls 10 g, so about 30 g.

These macros add up to about 780 kcal rather than 865, so I scaled them up slightly: protein 22 g, carbohydrate 140 g, fat 35 g.
